Madh-e-Abbas Madh-e-Haider Hai.
Jaisay Lashkar Ke Pichey Lashkar Hai.

1
Ik Nuseri Ka Ik Wafa Ka Khuda.
Do Khudaon Ka Aik Hi Ghar Hai.
Aik Saqi Hai Aik Saqqa Hai.
Alqama Ik Ki Ik Ka Kausar Hai.

2
Ain Dono Ke Naam Mein Shamil.
Our Alam Dono Ka Muqadar Hai.
Ik Ali Dosra Hai Nad-e-Ali.
Aik Dil Mein Hai Aik Lab Par.

3
Dushman-e-Deen-e-Mustafa Ke Liye.
Aik Talwar Aik Khanjar Hai.
Garna Hai Alam Hadaf Lekin.
Ik Ka Pani Hai Ik Ka Pathar Hai.

4
Dono Zainab Ke Sath Sath Hain Youn.
Aik Saya Hai Aik Chadar Hai.
Matla Rehan Nazar-e-Ghazi Tha.
Maqta Rehan Nazar-e-Haider Hai.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/madh-e-abbas-madh-e-haider-hai-tajpoints-a5937e591f3dfd7dc192.md')
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---', 2)[2]
def blocks(s):
    return [[line.strip() for line in block.splitlines()] for block in s.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert [[line.rstrip('.').casefold() for line in block] for block in blocks(old)] == [[line.casefold() for line in block] for block in blocks(roman)]
assert [len(block) for block in blocks(body)] == [2, 5, 5, 5, 5]
assert [block[0] for block in blocks(body)[1:]] == list('۱۲۳۴')
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Confirmed unchanged Roman wording and matching opening and four stanzas (18 verses).')
PY

Reconstructed all 18 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that the two-line opening and four stanzas align. Updated the title and right-to-left metadata and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous “Garna” in stanza 3 as `گڑنا`.
